text: An MCP server and CLI (Python package `gms-mcp`, with `src/gms_mcp` and `src/gms_helpers`) that lets coding agents read, edit, build and run GameMaker projects, plus a Cloudflare telemetry service. Judge it as GameMaker agent tooling infrastructure, not as a game: tool design, GameMaker correctness, validation and agent safety.
layout: MCP server: `src/gms_mcp/**` (server, tool registration in `server/tools/`, tool types and schemas).

GameMaker helpers and CLI core: `src/gms_helpers/**` (`gms.py` CLI, asset/event/room/project helpers, run sessions, runtime discovery, locks, snapshot builds, workflow); `cli/` holds the legacy launchers (`gms`, `gms.bat`, `install.py`, `agent_setup.py`).
Tests: `cli/tests/python/**` (pytest, `testpaths` in `pyproject.toml`), MCP conformance fixtures in `cli/tests/fixtures/`.
Telemetry service: `services/telemetry/` (Cloudflare Worker, node:test tests, Biome).

Out of scope: prose docs (`documentation/`, `docs/`, `cli/docs/`; `documentation/COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md` is generated), the gitignored `gamemaker/` sample projects and `test_project.yyp` fixture, and local agent config (`.agents/`, `.mcp.json`, `.cursor/`).
focus: MCP tool design and ergonomics: registration, schemas, error handling and logging
GameMaker correctness of asset, event, room and `.yyp` operations, respecting GameMaker asset-organisation rules
Validation, testability and agent safety (locks, transactional writes, trusted command lookup)
Python helper architecture and the CLI/MCP boundary
Release, packaging and CI quality gates
Sample and generated GameMaker projects are fixtures, not authored product logic
inspect: MCP server/tool registration, schemas, command execution, error handling and logging
GameMaker asset/project helpers, `.yyp` manipulation, folder/path handling, event/room operations and validation
run sessions, runtime discovery and multi-agent locks
tests, package config, CI, setup scripts and generated-artifact exclusions
checks: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
COVERAGE_CORE=ctrace uv run --frozen pytest --cov --cov-context=test --junitxml=build/reports/junit.xml && uv run --frozen coverage json --show-contexts -o build/reports/coverage.json

uv run --frozen python scripts/run_mcp_tool_smoke.py --init-minimal-base --base-project build/mcp-smoke/base-project --work-root build/mcp-smoke/work --output build/reports/mcp_tool_smoke_report.json --tools gm_safe_delete gm_create_object gm_event_add gm_maintenance_validate_json gm_room_instance_add gm_room_layer_add gm_verification_status gm_list_assets gm_project_info gm_search_references gm_workflow_duplicate gm_sprite_frame_count
uv run --frozen python scripts/build_release.py --output-dir dist && uv run --frozen python scripts/verify_package_artifacts.py dist

cd services/telemetry && npm run check && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=../../build/reports/telemetry-junit.xml test/*.test.js
uv export --frozen --all-extras --format requirements-txt --no-emit-project | uv run --frozen pip-audit --requirement /dev/stdin --no-deps --disable-pip --strict --progress-spinner off
private: Do not inspect secrets or unrelated local app state.
